svg.aria-label: Three-panel architecture of AF2-AtomRes-DTA. Panel A: a protein sequence goes to ESM-C for per-residue embeddings and to AlphaFold2 for a contact map; the two combine into a residue graph read by ProteinGraphNet, which emits both a pooled protein vector and per-residue embeddings that feed a residue prior. Panel B: a drug SMILES goes to RDKit for a molecular graph and to ChemBERTa for token embeddings, each read by its own encoder. Panel C: the two graph vectors are combined by gated fusion, the two sequence tensors meet in structure-guided atom-residue attention biased by the residue prior, and the four resulting vectors are concatenated and passed to a KAN block that outputs a binding affinity score.
